morning.textArabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
morning.textEnglish: We have entered a new morning and with it all dominion belongs to Allah. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner.

morning.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
morning.textEnglish: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

morning.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
morning.textEnglish: Sayyid al-Istighfar (The Master Supplication for Forgiveness): O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped but You. You created me and I am Your servant...

morning.textArabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
morning.textEnglish: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the sky can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

morning.textArabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
morning.textEnglish: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (pbuh) as my Prophet.

morning.textArabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
morning.textEnglish: O Ever Living One, O Self-Existing One, by Your mercy I seek assistance. Rectify for me all my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him. (Whoever says this 100 times in the morning and evening, his sins will be forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea).

evening.textArabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
evening.textEnglish: We have entered the evening and with it all dominion belongs to Allah. Praise is to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone.

evening.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
evening.textEnglish: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.

evening.textArabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
evening.textEnglish: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

evening.textArabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
evening.textEnglish: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the sky can cause harm.
Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him (100 times).

post_prayer.textArabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
post_prayer.textEnglish: I seek forgiveness from Allah (3 times).

post_prayer.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ
post_prayer.textEnglish: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.

post_prayer.textArabic: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
post_prayer.textEnglish: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner (To complete the hundred).

sleep.textArabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
sleep.textEnglish: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I arise. If You keep my soul, have mercy upon it, and if You send it back, protect it as You protect Your righteous slaves.
O Allah, in Your name I die and I live.

sleep.textArabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33) ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33) ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (34)
sleep.textEnglish: The Tasbeeh of Fatimah: SubhanAllah (33), Alhamdulillah (33), Allahu Akbar (34).
